question: Should this be handled as a private production/payment/account incident, or is there a repo-owned deploy bug that should be tracked separately?
rationale: The public checkout does not contain the reported hosted route/action, and the next useful evidence is production payment/account state that automation cannot access or safely discuss publicly.

options.title: Private operator investigation
options.body: Inspect the production request, payment/webhook record, and account/project state privately before deciding whether a source issue exists.

options.title: Open a narrow repo bug
options.body: If private logs identify a ClawHub-owned route, action, or deploy contract, create a redacted follow-up with the exact source boundary and reproduction evidence.

options.title: Resolve as external/admin-only
options.body: If the payment or hosted account state was corrected outside this repo with no source change needed, close after leaving a redacted operator note.

recommendation.title: Private operator investigation
recommendation.body: Inspect the production request, payment/webhook record, and account/project state privately before deciding whether a source issue exists.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and blame point this handle at the Convex/API and deploy-runbook surfaces closest to the reported hosted deploy action.
